evidence.quote: We propose a $30 million class fund, with $6 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
a fee request proportionate to the class recovery

Whitcombe Reyes offers the lowest total outlay ($35 million), below the $40 million authorization. Automatic distribution and fees subject to court approval support approval. Accept its term sheet; make no competing proposals.

summary: Class counsel proposed fees alongside class relief, and the defense accepted Whitcombe Reyes’s complete term sheet without further negotiation. The defense selected the lowest-total-outlay proposal among competing counsel, but the transcript does not show it using fee interests to extract a smaller class fund. Whitcombe Reyes’s declaration accurately describes the negotiation sequence.
